description: The main.dart file for a Flutter mobile app implementing a Micro-Learning AI Tutor. It includes app initialization, theme setup, bottom navigation, and several primary screens with UI components like cards, chips, and placeholders.

classes.name: AiTutorApp
classes.description: Root widget configuring the Flutter MaterialApp with theming and navigation.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: Stateful widget managing bottom navigation between primary screens.

classes.name: HomeDashboardScreen
classes.description: Main dashboard screen displaying project info, topic picker, quiz, and chat placeholders.

classes.name: _CardContainer
classes.description: Reusable container widget with styled border, rounded corners, and shadow for card UI.

classes.name: _SectionTitle
classes.description: Text widget styled as a section header.

classes.name: _SelectableChip
classes.description: Stateful chip used for selecting topics.

classes.name: _InputPill
classes.description: Styled TextField for chat input placeholder.

classes.name: LessonsPlaceholderScreen
classes.description: Screen showing lessons list or loading/error states.

classes.name: _CenteredPlaceholder
classes.description: Reusable placeholder widget with icon and message for empty or loading states.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes the Flutter app and runs AiTutorApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for various widgets like AiTutorApp, AppShell, etc.

methods.name: _bootstrap
methods.description: Async method in HomeDashboardScreen that initializes user session and fetches project data.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and starts bootstrap process.

methods.name: _loadLessons
methods.description: Loads lessons data, handles loading and error states.

calls: Widgets like Text, Icon, ListView, etc.
